Admin Module Server

Source: R/modul_admin.R
adminServer.Rd

Implements the server-side administration workflows for managing users and permissions, case texts, bibliographic sources, coding scales, team reliability dashboards, targeted coding search and value edits, CSV data import/export, and relational database integrity diagnostics.

Usage

adminServer(
  id,
  db_con,
  current_user = NULL,
  current_user_id = NULL,
  scales_trigger = NULL,
  current_lang = reactiveVal("de"),
  current_role = NULL
)

Arguments

id

Character string specifying the Shiny module namespace identifier.

db_con

Active DBIConnection or pool::Pool database handle.

current_user

Optional reactive expression or character scalar identifying the currently signed-in administrator's username.

current_user_id

Optional reactive expression or integer scalar identifying the currently signed-in administrator's user_id.

scales_trigger

Optional reactiveVal incremented whenever scale definitions are added or modified so other modules refresh dynamically.

current_lang

Reactive expression or character scalar providing the active UI language code ("de" or "en").

current_role

Optional reactive expression or character scalar identifying the active user's role ("admin" or "user"). When provided (e.g., by coding_manager_server()), server-side admin handlers enforce that the role equals "admin". Defaults to NULL for backward compatibility with standalone module invocations and tests.

Value

The return value of shiny::moduleServer().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
adminServer(
  id = "mod_admin",
  db_con = db_con,
  current_user = reactive("admin"),
  current_user_id = reactive(1L),
  scales_trigger = reactiveVal(0L)
)
} # }
